silicon_quenching_1_subtask_structure_re.name: Silicon Structure Retrieval for Quenching - Level 1
silicon_quenching_1_subtask_structure_re.description: Retrieve structure of Silicon (or a molten restart) and convert it to LAMMPS data format. Return the absolute path of the final structure.

silicon_quenching_1_subtask_potential_fi.name: Silicon Potential File for Quenching - Level 1
silicon_quenching_1_subtask_potential_fi.description: Procure the appropriate Stillinger–Weber (SW) potential file for Silicon for MD simulations. Return the absolute path to the potential file.

silicon_quenching_1_subtask_quenching.name: Silicon NPT Quenching - Level 1
silicon_quenching_1_subtask_quenching.description: Given paths to LAMMPS-compatible Silicon molten structure and Stillinger–Weber potential file appropriate for MD simulations, simulate the quenching process by cooling the system under NPT. As the final output, return the final density and the absolute path to the simulation log file.

silicon_quenching_1_subtask_tg_detection.name: Silicon Glass Transition Temperature Detection - Level 1
silicon_quenching_1_subtask_tg_detection.description: Given the path to the log file from the quenching simulation, analyze the density versus temperature data to detect the glass transition temperature (Tg). Tg is defined as the temperature at which the slope of density versus temperature changes significantly. Report the Tg value in Kelvin.
